box.highlights: Dylan Craig rushed 21 times for 145 yards and two touchdowns, made five PATs and had an interception and a fumble recovery to lead Bayport-Blue Point to a 35-0 win over Miller Place in a Suffolk IV opener.

Miller Place 31, Mt. Sinai 21: Braeden Murphy rushed for two touchdowns in the fourth quarter and made 15 tackles on defense to lead Miller Place (1-1) in Suffolk IV. Shane Kiernan went 18-for-23 passing with 220 yards and a rushing touchdown. Jayden Meadows had 20 carries for 124 yards and a touchdown. AJ Rudolph caught seven passes for 65 yards. Dane LaGrasta made three catches for 81 yards. Ryan Filippi caught a touchdown, rushed for a touchdown and threw a touchdown for Mt. Sinai (1-1).

Miller Place 41, Port Jefferson: Shane Kiernan completed nine of 11 passes for 202 yards and four touchdowns to lead visitor Miller Place (2-1) in Suffolk IV. Ethan Monaco had three catches for 126 yards and two touchdowns, AJ Rudolph had three catches for 36 yards and a touchdown and Dane LaGrasta had two catches for 34 yards and a touchdown. Jayden Meadows had eight carries for 62 yards and a touchdown and Braeden Murphy made 11 tackles on defense. Camryn Hardy added four sacks, an interception, and a rushing touchdown.

Babylon 57, Miller Place 48: Aidan Winter had 21 carries for 284 yards and two touchdowns to lead host Babylon (4-0) in Suffolk IV. Kai Jankow had 17 rushes for 188 yards and four touchdowns. Keven Bonilla threw a 75-yard touchdown pass to Charlie Bunger to put Babylon ahead 30-13 before halftime. Daniel DeBetta had a 1-yard touchdown run. Babylon earned a stop on the potential tying two-point conversion pass with four minutes left. Jankow's 4-yard TD run with a minute left extended Babylon's lead to 57-48.
Shane Kiernan completed 38 of 54 passes for 523 yards and six touchdowns for Miller Place (2-2). Kiernan broke the single-game school records for completions, passing yards and touchdown passes, according to coach Adam St. Nicholas. Dane Lagrasta had 11 catches for 216 yards and three touchdowns. Dj Williamson had 11 catches for 219 yards and three touchdowns, and he also had a two-point conversion reception. Williamson and Lagrasta both broke the school record for receptions in a single game and Williamson broke the school record for receiving yards in a single game.

Miller Place 57, Southampton 0: Shane Kiernan was 10 for 11 for 131 yards and three touchdowns, setting up a 28-point first quarter for Miller Place (3-2) in its home win in Suffolk IV. Ethan Monaco had five catches for 81 yards, and AJ Rudolph had two receptions for 29 yards and two touchdowns. Gavin Peterson ran four times for 56 yards and two touchdowns. Camryn Hardy took three carries for 48 yards and a TD. Lee Walcott and Tristan Rodriguez both had interceptions on defense. Southampton is 1-4.

Miller Place 41, Shoreham-Wading River 7: Shane Kiernan completed 28 of 34 passes for 237 yards and one touchdown and one rushing touchdown to lead host Miller Place (4-2) in Suffolk IV. Braeden Murphy had two rushing touchdowns and one receiving touchdown and had 13 tackles and 5 TFLs on defense. Dane Lagrasta had six receptions for 100 yards and Ethan Monaco added a 45-yard touchdown run. Sean Casey caught a 5-yard touchdown pass from Noah Gregorek for Shoreham-Wading River (3-3).

Miller Place 21, Glenn 14: Shane Kiernan completed 25 of 34 passing attempts for 333 yards and three touchdowns, and Dane LaGrasta had eight receptions for 190 yards and two TDs as the duo lead Miller Place (5-2) to a road win in Suffolk IV. Kiernan connected with LaGrasta for a 6-yard touchdown with seven minutes remaining in the fourth quarter for the go-ahead score. Kevin Washington ended Glenn's final drive with a sack in the red zone on 4th down. Braeden Murphy led the defense with 12 tackles, including one for a loss and a pass break-up. DJ Williamson added 9 catches for 91 yards and a touchdown. Russell Dada impressed on the edge. Cole Madden threw a 13-yard touchdown pass to Joe Competiello to start the scoring for Glenn (3-4), and KaRahn King added a 13-yard rushing score in the second quarter.

Miller Place 42, Greenport/Southold/Mattituck 6: Shane Kiernan completed 9 of 10 passes for 203 yards and four touchdowns to lead host Miller Place (6-2) in Suffolk IV. Dane Lagrasta, Tristen Rodriguez, Dj Williamson and AJ Rudolph each had touchdown catches. Rudolph had two catches for 71 yards and Williamson had two catches for 41 yards. Ethan Monaco had a 34-yard interception return touchdown. Michael DeNicola threw a 48-yard touchdown pass to Luke Weir for Greenport/Southold/Mattituck (4-4).

Miller Place 36, Shoreham-Wading River 12: D.J. Williamson had five receptions for 121 yards and three touchdowns to lead host No. 3 Miller Place over No. 6 Shoreham-Wading River in the Suffolk Division IV quarterfinals. Ethan Monaco had an 20-yard interception return for a touchdown with 2:30 left in the second quarter to give Miller Place a 22-0 lead. Monaco also added a 4-yard rushing touchdown. Shane Kiernan threw for 170 yards and three touchdowns. Jayden Meadows rushed for 128 yards on 17 carries. Braeden Murphy had 12 tackles, including two for a loss. Kevin Washington added seven tackles and 1 tackle for loss.

Miller Place 43, Babylon 14: Shane Kiernan completed 20-of-26 passes for 421 yards and five touchdowns to lead visiting No. 3 Miller Place over No. 2 Babylon in the Suffolk IV semifinals on Friday night. On the third play of the game, DJ Williamson had a 37-yard reception to set up a one-yard touchdown run by Braeden Murphy. Williamosn had three catches for 92 yards and a touchdown.Ethan Monaco had eight catches for 133 yards a touchdown and caught an interception in the endzone. Dane LaGrasta had three catches for 108 yards, two touchdowns and an interception. AJ Rudolph had five catches for 65 yards and a touchdown and Jayden Meadows rushed for 60 yards on 13 carries. Quinn Doyen made 10 tackles and Braeden Murphy had eight. Kevin Washington and Jackson Thompson each had six tackles. Miller Place (8-2) will face No. 1 Bayport-Blue Point at 6 p.m. on Thursday at Stony Brook University in the championship. Kai Jankow had two rushing touchdowns for Babylon (8-2).
Bayport-Blue Point defeated Miller Place to secure its third straight Suffolk Division IV title.
